researchers. It opens in a flooded yard where a smartphone warning arrives too late, presents the standalone solar-powered station equipped
with four optical level sensors, shows how an onboard TinyML chip calculates flood risk locally without cell towers or central cloud servers
, illustrates radio signal distribution to an emergency response hub displaying predictive flood paths, and clarifies that the system currently has 9

8.82% post-training validation accuracy with no field installations yet deployed.",
